reasons_add: Abū Bakr transmits the forty-year interval from Ibn ʿAbbās through Abū Ḥuṣayn and Abū al-Ḍuḥā; al-Shaʿbī and ʿĀmir also identify the earlier and later boasts.
Al-Ṭabarī, al-Shaʿbī and ʿĀmir connect Pharaoh's punishment with both his earlier claim in 28:38 and his later claim here.
Al-Thaʿlabī reports an unnamed explanation that calls the idols lords and makes Pharaoh lord of both the idols and the people.
